summary: A dispatched worker has no general Concord state-query or mutation access. Its packet remains complete declared context. Explicit capabilities expose bounded pinned readings, scoped review diffs and recorded executable checks, not discovery or workflow authority. Review starts at the immutable pre-edit commit recorded by the authenticated initial worktree producer, covering coordinator and worker edits. The record binds work, Project and claim. Older work retains its recorded first editing dispatch subject; missing authentic history refuses without backfill or inference. Contract revisions do not reset the foundation. Reads remain within approved job paths, use immutable Git bytes and revalidate the active attempt. Native-oracle receipt authority stays with the host. Utilities retain complete Concord-tool denial.
title: Worker lanes use declared context and bounded host capabilities
